info.name: PayPal Seed API
info.description:
Postman collection for PayPal Seed: savings (F1), microloans (F2), the fair loan check (F3), the repayment schedule (F4), the credit record (F6), identity, the PayPal catalog bootstrap, the desk queues, the reserve, fraud flags and the member home call.

Run the folders in order. Ids (goalId, assessmentId, applicationId, loanId, shareId, flagId, coverRequestId) are saved to collection variables.

Authentication: against a dev, test or demo backend the requests send X-Seed-Member-Id, X-Seed-Staff-Id and X-Seed-Staff-Roles. Against a deployed backend set the variables actorToken (member) and staffToken (staff): the pre-request script then sends Authorization: Bearer instead of the X-Seed headers. /internal/** routes always use internalToken (SEED_INTERNAL_TOKEN).
